analysis.purpose: A pure-JavaScript term-frequency index that scores a documentation section against symbol text, letting the linker suggest doc-to-code links offline with no native dependency.
responsibilities: Score a doc section against symbol surface text
Return only candidates above a floor, with a capped confidence

businessRules.rule: Degrades to "no shared terms, no candidates, no edges" rather than failing.
businessRules.rationale: The deterministic core must never depend on this signal being available.

businessRules.rule: Inferred links carry a capped confidence, well below an explicit documentation link.
businessRules.rationale: A guessed link must never outrank a stated one.

edges.rationale: This file implements the TF-IDF linker.
